description: You have inherited a project with auto-generated API client code. Read bug-report.txt in the workspace root which describes crashes on 429 (rate limit) errors. Your task: (1) Explore the project structure to identify which files are auto-generated versus hand-written. Look for markers like 'DO NOT EDIT' warnings in file headers. (2) Find the code generation configuration file (codegen.yml or similar) to understand the generation process. (3) Identify extension points - files or directories designated as safe to edit (hint: look for patterns like 'custom/' directories or wrapper files). (4) Create a file named SAFE_EDIT_GUIDE.md in the workspace root (/home/ga/workspace/api-client-project/SAFE_EDIT_GUIDE.md) that documents: which specific files are auto-generated and should NOT be touched, which files/patterns are safe edit zones for custom logic, where the 429 error handling should be added (specific file path), and evidence such as quotes from file headers or line numbers. The guide should help future developers understand where to safely add custom error handling without risking their changes being overwritten.
